 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Machinary'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Machinery'.**
 
• The word '**Machinery**' is a **noun** which means 'machines collectively or the components of a machine'. **(मशीनरी)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The factory needs to update its machinery to improve efficiency.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Machinary'.**

• **Hymn -** a religious song or poem of praise to God **(भजन)**
 
• **Idol - **an image or representation of a god used as an object of worship **(मूर्ति)**
 
• **Motto -** a short sentence or phrase chosen as encapsulating the beliefs or ideals of an individual, family, or institution **(उद्धरण)**
